sentences.text: Issue No.1 :- In the evidence PW1 stated that on on 21.09.2021 at 3.40 p.m. , when her husband G.S.Channappa was riding Honda Activa bearing No.KA- 41-EF-6073 from Subbaiah Circle towards Lalbagh main gate, driver of Maruti Omni car bearing No.KA-03-AA-5748 drove the same negligently from cross road of S.N.Narayana Layout, turned towards right , dashed the same to Honda Activa , thereby caused the accident, caused grievous injuries to G.S.Channappa.

PW1 stated that immediately after the accident injured has been shifted to NIMHANS , wherein first aid has been provided, then admitted to Sevakshetra hospital for treatment , wherein on 28.09.2021 G.S.Channappa succumbed to the injuries.
13. In the written statements respondents No. 1 and 3 denied the allegation regarding reason and mode of accident .
14. In the cross-examination, PW1 admitted that she was not present with her husband during accident.
PW1 stated that as per sketch on the middle of the junction of 3 roads accident might have taken place between 2 wheeler and the car.
PW1 denied the suggestion that accident was not taken place due to negligence of the driver of the car.
15. In the evidence RW1 officer of the Bajaj General Insurance company stated nothing regarding reason and mode of the accident.

16. Ex.P.1 is the copy of the FIR pertaining to crime No.511/21 registered by Wilsongarden Traffic police on 22.09.2021 at 17.30 hours against the driver of the Maruti Omni car bearing No.KA-03-AA-5748 for having committed offence punishable under Section 279, 337 of IPC Section 134 (A & B), 187 of IMV Act on the basis of the complaint presented by G.S.Channappa, S/o. Late Sadashivaiah i.e., statement of G.S.Channappa recorded in the hospital.
17. Ex.P.2 is the copy of the statement of G.S.Channappa recorded in the hospital.
Ex . P.3

is the copy of P.M.Report, Ex.P.4 is the copy of inquest mahazar, Ex.P.5 is the copy of chargesheet filed by wilsongarden Traffic police in crime No.51/2021 against Shivaraju, S/o. Krishnamurthy, driver of Maruti Omni car bearing No.KA- 03-AA-5748 for having committed offence punishable under Section 279, 337 of IPC Section 134 (A & B), 187, 184C of IMV Act .
Ex . P.6
is the copy of spot mahazar.

Ex.P.7 is the copy of sketch of the place of accident in which it is noted that on the main road situated between Lalbagh main road and Urvashi junction and cross road of S.N.Narayana badavane, Vinobha Nagara accident taken place between Honda Activa bearing No.KA-41-EF-6073 which was running on the main road and the Maruti Omni car bearing No.KA-03-AA-5748 which entered the main road from cross road.
Ex.P.8 is the copy of Motor Vehicle Accident Report.
Ex.P.9 is the death certificate.
18. In this case, there are no reasons to disbelieve the evidence placed by the petitioners regarding reason, mode and consequence of the accident.

19. Hence, I have concluded that on 21.09.2021 at 3.40 p.m. , when G.S.Channappa was riding Honda Activa bearing No.KA-41-EF-6073 on Lalbagh main road, near Passport office, Bengaluru,
Shivaraju, S/o.Krishnamurthy, negligently drove Maruti Omni car bearing No.KA-03-AA- 5748 Rajeshwari K vs United India Ins Co Ltd on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/33057443/
4 from S.N.Narayana layout cross road to the main road dashed the same to Honda Activa , thereby caused the accident, caused grievous injuries to G.S.Channappa, who succumbed to those injuries in Sevakshetra hospital on 28.09.2021.
Hence, I answer issue No. 1 in the Affirmative .
20. Issue No.3:

In the lengthy argument, the learned Advocate for the insurance company by analyzing the evidence available on file regarding damages collected by the petitioners from Bajaj allianz General Insurance Company insurer of Honda Activa under own damage clause submitted that in this case petitioners are not entitle to receive damages by relying on the judgment of Hon'ble High Court of Karnataka reported in 2006 ACJ 2566 ( D.I.Narayana swamy and another Vs.
National Insurance Co. Ltd and another)

sentences.text: In the light of the judgment cited above, with reference to the submission made on behalf of respondent No.1/insurance company and petitioners, I have appreciated the material available in the file regarding damages.

22. In the evidence PW1 stated that as on the date of accident her husband deceased G.S.Channappa being aged 52 years, used to earn Rs.4,50,000/-per annum by doing agriculture , by vending milk,
by doing real estate business and used to contribute entire income to the family.
23. In the written statements respondents No.1 and 2 denied the allegation regarding occupation and income of the deceased.

24. In the cross-examination, PW1 denied the suggestion that as on the date of accident her husband never earned Rs.3,60,000/- or Rs.2,00,000/- per annum (Rs.18,000/- + Rs.15,000/- per month)
from agriculture and vending milk.
PW1 submitted that as per bill produced at Sl.No.1 and 2 herself and her children have spent Rs.1,30,539/- and Rs.59,672/- towards treatment of her deceased husband.

25. In the cross-examination dated 30.09.2024 PW1 submitted that insurer of the Honda Activa bearing No.KA- 41-EF-6073 paid approximately Rs.12,200/- under own damage clause, however,
she has spent Rs.34,000/- towards repair of the Honda Activa .
PW1 denied the suggestion that about receiving of Rs.12,200/- towards full and final settlement of the damages with respect Honda Activa bearing No.KA-41-EF-6073 from insurer of Honda Activa .

26. In the evidence RW1, Automobile Engineer at Bajaj GIC , Bengaluru branch produced copy of package policy of Honda Activa bearing No.KA-41-EF-6073 , claim petition submitted by G.S.Channappa , copy of survey report, invoice dated 30.12.2021, copy of claim summary sheet,
copy of own damages estimated to Rs.5,623/- to Rs.5,922/- credited to the account of G.S.Channappa towards full and final settlement at Ex.R.1 to R.6.
27.
In the cross-examination RW1 stated that in terms of policy marked at Ex.R.1 in total bill amount of Rs.23,412/-, insurance company paid Rs.11,544/-.

sentences.text: In the ration card marked at Ex.P.17, for the year 2020-21 age of deceased G.S.Channappa is noted as 53 years.

In the copy of aadhar card , DL and SSLC marks card marked at Exs.P.20 to P.22,
date of birth of G.S.Channappa is noted as 09.07.1968/07.11.1073 respectively.
The medical bills shows that petitioners have spent approximately Rs.1,90,211/- towards treatment charges of G.S.Channappa.
29. Copy of the partition deed , Record of Rights marked at Ex.P.18 and P.19 shows that G.S.Channappa owned agricultural lands situated at Vasanthanahalli village of Bangaluru South taluk.
30. The copy of ration card and aadhar card shows that the petitioners are the wife and children of G.S.Channappa.
In the file there are no documents regarding quantum of income of deceased G.S.Channappa.

31. Hence, I have calculated compensation under the head of loss of dependency presuming that as on the date of incident G.S.Channappa being aged 53 years, used to earn Rs.15,000/p.m. by adding 10% as future prospectus , deducting 1/3rd towards personal expenses and by applying multiplier 11 in the following terms:
Age of the deceased G.S.Channappa as on 53 years the date of accident -  No. of dependants of deceased 3  G.S.Channappa  Monthly notional income of deceased - Rs.15,000/-
G.S.Channappa as on the date of accident Add: 10% future prospects Rs.16,500/-
15,000x10/100=1,500+15,000=16,500 Less : 1/ 3rd towards personal expenses of Rs.11,000/- the deceased G.S.Channappa (16,500 - 5,500/- = 11,000)

Annual income of the deceased 11,000x12 Rs.1,32,000/- Loss of dependency 1,32,000x11 Rs.14,52,000/-
32.
Hence, I award Rs.14,52,000/- towards loss of dependency.

Rs.16,500/- towards loss of estate,
Rs.16,500/- towards funeral expenses , Rs.44,000/- towards spousal consortium to petitioner No.1,
Rs.88,000/- towards parental consortium to petitioners No.2 and 3 at the rate of Rs.44,000/- each,
Rs.1,90,211/- towards treatment charges, Rs.10,000/- towards attendant, conveyance charges.

33. Hence, I came to the conclusion that the petitioners being wife and children of deceased G.S.Channappa are entitle to receive Rs.18,17,211/- with current and future interest at the rate of 6%
p.a. as compensation from the respondents.

Attendant, conveyance 10,000-00 charges Total 18,17,211-00 Hence, I answer issue No.2 accordingly.

34. Issue No.3: In Ex.P.13 and Ex.R.1 copy of the policy with respect to Honda Activa bearing No.KA-41-EF- 6073 , the year of the manufacturing is noted as 2016 and insured declared value is noted as Rs.27,471/-

, Motor Vehicle Accident Report, invoice marked at Exs.P.8 and P.12 shows that petitioners get replaced several parts of the Honda Activa bearing No.KA-41-EF-6073 which are not damaged in the alleged incident.

Considering the date of the manufacturing of Honda Activa ,
date of accident, insured declared value of the Honda Activa noted in Ex.P.13/Ex.R.1, I have inferred that in view of the damage suffered by the Honda Activa in the accident , petitioners have suffered damages worth of Rs.11,545/- which has been already paid by the Bajaj General Insurance company under own damages clause of the policy marked at Ex.P.13/Ex.R.1.

Hence, in this case petitioners are not entitle to receive damages from the respondents No.1 and 3.
35.
In the written statements, respondents No.1 and 3 admitted that as on the date of accident Maruti Omni car bearing No.KA-03-AA-5748 had insurance coverage with respondent No.1 insurance company.
In the file there are no evidence to show that as on the date of incident respondent No.3 has violated any terms of the policy.

Hence, I came to the conclusion that the respondents being the insurer and owner of Maruti Omni car bearing No.KA- 03-AA-5748 are liable to pay compensation and an award is to be passed directing the respondents No.1 and 3 to pay compensation to the petitioners,

Hence, I answer issue No.3 accordingly and pass the following :
ORDER
The petition filed under Section 166 of IMV Act is hereby partly allowed.

The respondents No.1 and 3 being the insurer and owner of Maruti Omni car bearing No.KA-03-AA-5748 shall either jointly or severally pay Rs.18,17,211/- with current and future interest at the rate of 6% p.a., to petitioners towards compensation.
The respondent No.1, being the Insurer of the Maruti Omni car bearing No.KA-03-AA-5748 shall deposit the compensation amount with interest within 3 months from today.
The compensation amount and interest are distributed among petitioners equally .
